newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen weakness unlikely to continue - Japan EPA.
newsitem.headline: Yen weakness unlikely to continue - Japan EPA.

text.p: The recent weakening of the yen is unlikely to continue, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso said on Tuesday.
He also said it was undesirable for exchange rates to fluctuate sharply.
"What is most troubling is for the rate to move sharply. But I don't think the yen's weakening will continue," he told a regular news conference.
Asked whether a rise in import prices brought about by the yen's depreciation was affecting domestic prices, Aso said both wholesale prices and consumer prices had so far been unaffected.
Aso also said the impact of the rise in the consumption tax from the beginning of April had so far been within expectations.
He added that a fall in sales by department stores in April had also been within expectations.
